20244.long_desc:
With a durable steel structure, This Desktop Mount Monitor Stand provides stable support for single 17 - 34 inch monitors of 12kg (24.4lbs).  

Flexible design for ample adjustment and viewing angles with a 45°/45° tilt range and 30°/30° swivel range, adjustable for either portrait or landscape orientation with full 180° rotation. Including a locking rotary knob to ensure a secure position at any height setting.

The freestanding base provides stability and support on any work surface. A detachable VESA plate for user-friendly installation. 

Cable clips included for an organized and clutter-free workplace.
